blinding_guess.why: Within qt_gui the provided classes and set_action_attributes are consistent with how the package itself reads them (base path read from attributes key 'plugin_path'; 'package_path' is never read). Whether this is a mismatch depends on which attribute key the external plugin providers set, which is not in this package. Two latent error-path issues are visible in the icon consumer: set_action_attributes stores icontype=None explicitly, so plugin_menu's .get('icontype', 'file') default never applies and an icon given without an icontype raises 'unknown icon type' (plugin_menu.py:122,138-139); and the 'resource' branch formats the unbound local 'path' in its not-found error (plugin_menu.py:134).

notes: Snapshot is the qt_gui_core repository (0.2.10) holding several packages; only snapshot/qt_gui was treated as this package (qt_gui_cpp etc. were read only for context and not recorded). All elements are Python API symbols of a ROS 1 (groovy) package: msg_type, units, QoS, rates and definition_id are null; frame recorded as 'none' because none of these symbols carry spatial data. attributes.package_path (consumes): qt_gui never reads this key at this revision (grep of all files under snapshot/qt_gui for 'package_path' finds only the unrelated function ros_package_helper.get_package_path at ros_package_helper.py:32 and its use in about_handler.py:40,52), so it has no port and is not in references. The icon base path is read from attributes().get('plugin_path') (plugin_menu.py:62,107) and joined with the icon for icontype 'file' (plugin_menu.py:126-127). PluginProvider.discover/load are defined as NotImplementedError stubs in the provided base class (plugin_provider.py:42-54) and are called by qt_gui on provider instances (plugin_manager.py:103, plugin_handler_direct.py:54, composite_plugin_provider.py:58,71, recursive_plugin_provider.py:50,57); PluginProvider also declares unload (plugin_provider.py:56), not a packet element. set_action_attributes is also called internally by container_manager.py:46. references lists only packet elements; imports from python_qt_binding are not listed. No exclusive resources or permissions exist in this pure-Python GUI library.
